nodes.summary: Let $m \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $\varphi \colon \mathbb{R} \to M_m(\mathbb{C})$ be a one-parameter group of complex $m \times m$ matrices. For every real $t$, the element of $\mathrm{GL}_m(\mathbb{C})$ assigned to $t$ by the lift of $\varphi$ has underlying matrix $\varphi(t)$.
nodes.title: Underlying matrix of the lift of a one-parameter group

nodes.summary: For every $m \in \mathbb{N}$ and every complex $m \times m$ matrix $A$, the map $t \mapsto \exp(tA)$ from $\mathbb{R}$ to the complex $m \times m$ matrices is a one-parameter group.
nodes.title: Exponential curves are one-parameter groups

nodes.summary: Let $m \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $G$ be a subgroup of $\mathrm{GL}_m(\mathbb{C})$. A map $\varphi \colon \mathbb{R} \to \mathrm{GL}_m(\mathbb{C})$ is a one-parameter group in $G$ when the matrix-valued map $t \mapsto \varphi(t)$ is a one-parameter group and $\varphi(t) \in G$ for every real $t$.
nodes.title: One-parameter group in a subgroup of the general linear group

nodes.summary: For $m \in \mathbb{N}$, a map $\varphi \colon \mathbb{R} \to M_m(\mathbb{C})$ into the complex $m \times m$ matrices is a one-parameter group when $\varphi(0)$ is the identity matrix $I$, $\varphi(s + t) = \varphi(s)\,\varphi(t)$ for all real $s$ and $t$, and $\varphi$ is differentiable.
nodes.title: One-parameter group of complex matrices

nodes.summary: Let $m \in \mathbb{N}$. If $\varphi \colon \mathbb{R} \to M_m(\mathbb{C})$ is a one-parameter group of complex $m \times m$ matrices, then there is a unique matrix $A \in M_m(\mathbb{C})$ such that $\varphi(t) = \exp(tA)$ for every real $t$.
nodes.title: One-parameter groups of matrices are exponentials

nodes.summary: Let $m \in \mathbb{N}$ and let $\varphi \colon \mathbb{R} \to M_m(\mathbb{C})$ be a one-parameter group of complex $m \times m$ matrices. For every real $t$ the matrix $\varphi(t)$ is invertible with inverse $\varphi(-t)$; this gives the element of $\mathrm{GL}_m(\mathbb{C})$ with matrix $\varphi(t)$ and inverse $\varphi(-t)$.
nodes.title: The lift of a one-parameter group to the general linear group

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
